'''Darth Hoth BHBM Royal Guards v3.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]

== Strategy ==

Get out the Emperor on my first turn to my opponent's starting site and deploy some Royal Guards as backup (if I have enough force, if not, deploy a DB and save). Use the Inconsequential Losses to prevent the loss of Guards. Mobilization Points is good for the extra force generation and dropping the DV of Jedi. Use Strategic Reserves to prevent force drains and Imperial Domination, Abyssin Ornament and Imperial Reinforcements for retrieval. Search and Destroy will be good incase they refuse to come to the ground to battle me. Crossfire will increase my power when I use more than 1 Force Pike. The bridge is there for more activation. Weapon of an Ungrateful Son is used to put the Force Pikes back in my reserve deck if I'm short on force or about to win. Well Guarded protects my Guards from Grimtaash. I would like to add in some Presence of the Force and another Force Lightning, but I'm not sure what to take out.
